name: 時刻の書式と外部の説明を調整する利用設定
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Correct the section rhythm in LH07-0108. Image 1 controls radio anatomy; Image 2 is the candidate to edit; Image 3 controls exact Japanese positions, typography and content; Image 4 is approved style. Keep a compact 390x284 landscape panel. At 390px width, move the first heading to y=20 and the selected 12-hour row to y=59. Keep the 24-hour row near y=104 and first divider near y=140. Move the second heading down to y=171, its selected description row to y=208, the lower divider to y=244 and footer text to y=255. In Image 2, the second group and footer are10-15px too high; restore the preview separation. Keep section padding modest and comfortable. Preserve radio dimensions and alignment from the original crop. Use the exact strings with no inserted spaces: 時刻の書式; 12時間表記（例：午後2:00）; 24時間表記（例：14:00）; ウェブ上の説明を表示; 空のメモと、自分のメモの下に表示; プライバシーの説明・お問い合わせ. Preserve all selected/unselected states, green indicators, gray examples, dividers and quiet footer. Keep the title/label font sizes from Image 3; no extra whitespace, card, toolbar, footer duplication or added content.
